aboutText: Using innovative and contemporary design solutions, the skilled and passionate professionals at CNT Kitchens have been transforming mundane kitchen spaces into beautiful and functional areas across Derrimut and Melbourne's western suburbs for over 15 years. From initial consultation through to final installation, we help home and business owners create kitchens that truly reflect their personal style and lifestyle needs.
servicesText: CNT Kitchens offers a complete range of kitchen services from custom cabinetry to full renovations. Our Derrimut-based team delivers precision craftsmanship tailored to your home.
